skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply fundamental concepts of environmental chemistry, pollution, and environmental degradation.
Analyze and interpret chemical components and processes in air, water, and soil environments.
Conduct independent research and work collaboratively in teams to solve environmental chemistry problems.
Develop logical reasoning and analytical skills to address environmental issues.
Effectively communicate findings and solutions in both written and oral formats.
Demonstrate the ability to independently study and apply new knowledge in environmental chemistry.
Work effectively in groups and take leadership roles in environmental projects.
Apply scientific principles to solve real-world environmental problems.
